task: Add PUT/PATCH/DELETE /v1/provisioning/projects/{project_name}/budget as an all-or-nothing composite call on the moved caller-neutral budget service, with idempotent resend, required X-Change-Reference header, conditional manage-projects permission, and provisioning guide/AGENTS.md documentation.

key_reasoning.reason: Three write routes in the provisioning router package, new caller-neutral request/response models, the moved and renamed budget service, and a conditional permission check, all orchestrating existing project, cost-center, assignment and project-budget services across API and Service layers.

Closest pattern is the ServiceNow POST /budgets flow; business logic is reusable but the all-or-nothing guarantee is not: checks that today run after commit 1 (budget-group validation, conflict re-plan) must move before it, the post-commit concurrent-creation conflict must map to 5xx, and resend must converge after a LiteLLM provider failure mid-categories with provider idempotency unverified. Base L, bumped to XL for the authorization rule.

About 9 modified (provisioning router registration, ServiceNow router/models/service consumers, cost center service help text, verbatim log-string tests, OpenAPI baseline, endpoint-conventions guide, AGENTS.md) and about 6 new (budget routes, budget models, moved service, its tests, router tests, provisioning guide) across rest_api, service, tests and docs. Counts straddle L/XL; with the total on the 20/21 boundary and Technical Risk at XL, the borderline rule was applied by taking the higher reading. Matches the bundled L calibration example (epmcdme-10401, total 22).

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped from L to XL: affects authorization — provisioning:manage-projects is required only when the call creates the project or carries a project block, and the closest pattern (ServiceNow POST /budgets) has no such conditional check
